judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The 'Eeeeeek!' opener, the '?!' gratitude and the flat journal line imitate Nox well, but the middle of the offer is muddled ('I can keep the miners out, but you'll have to wade in yourself when you reach the pool down the west tunnel') and 'my strongbox can spare a fair bit of gold' is a stitched-on phrasing Westwood's terse quest-givers wouldn't use.
